script.title: NO HOT WATER IN MY ROOM
script.scene_zh: 飯店櫃台 · 反映熱水問題
script.story_hook: A guest finds freezing water in the morning shower.
script.intro_zh: 旅客早上洗澡才發現熱水完全是冷的。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, travelers! Today we're reporting a hotel problem.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，旅客朋友們！今天我們來反映飯店的問題。
script.outro: That's today's episode! Sleep well and keep listening.
script.outro_zh: 今天的節目就到這裡！好好睡，繼續聽。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each useful line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們把每個實用句子大聲跟讀一次。

script.youtube_title: 【🏨飯店英文實境】「沒有熱水」怎麼說才得體？🛁🔁換房・補償・搬行李一次學好｜聽完就會開口｜No Hot Water English
script.youtube_title_en: “What Seems to Be the Problem?” — Reporting No Hot Water at a Hotel
script.youtube_description:
早上洗澡才發現沒有熱水，要用英文怎麼有禮地反應？這段旅客與櫃台的對話，教你說明狀況、要求換房、接受補償。18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，出國住飯店不再卡殼。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

script.youtube_description_en:
Cold shower at 7 a.m. — how do you report it politely in English? This guest-and-desk conversation covers the problem, a room switch, and fair compensation. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a line-by-line repeat section. Check in with confidence tonight.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏨反映問題英文｜說明狀況・換房安排・早餐補償｜聽完就會求助｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
一大早想洗澡，水龍頭卻只有冰水，該怎麼辦？
用英文向櫃台反映，會不會緊張到講不好？

這一集帶大家走進早晨的飯店大廳，跟著旅客從說明狀況、聯絡師傅上門，到換房、行李搬運與早餐補償，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🛁 說明房間問題：例如 “There's no hot water in room 305.”、“The shower went ice cold.”。
🔧 聽懂處理進度：例如 “Let me call maintenance.”、“He can't fix it before nine.”。
🔄 換房與補償：例如 “We can switch your room right now.”、“We'll take care of breakfast today.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次住飯店遇到狀況，別悶著——好好說、慢慢講，他們一定會幫你！
script.scene: hotel front desk in the morning
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a room key card
script.title_quote: What seems to be the problem

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you — I need some help.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑ·ri tə ˈbɑ·tər ju aɪ niːd səm hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，抱歉打擾了——我需要一點幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. What seems to be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs wʌt siːmz tə bi ðə ˈprɑ·bləm/
dialogue.zh: 當然。請問出現了什麼問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's no hot water at all in room 305.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz noʊ hɑt ˈwɔ·tər ət ɔl ɪn rum θɜrˈi·oʊ ˈfaɪv/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's so frustrating. When did it start?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts soʊ frʌˈstreɪ·tɪŋ wɛn dɪd ɪt stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那真讓人生氣。是從什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning — my shower went ice cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔrn·ɪŋ maɪ ˈʃaʊ·ər wɛnt aɪs koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 今天早上——洗澡水整個冰得吃不消。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for telling us. I'll call maintenance now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈtɛ·lɪŋ ʌs aɪl kɔl ˈmeɪn·tə·nəns naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您告訴我們。我現在就聯絡維修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will it take? I have plans today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ɪt teɪk aɪ hæv plænz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 要修多久？我今天有行程安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can't reach it before nine, I'm afraid.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kænt riːtʃ ɪt bɪˈfɔr naɪn aɪm əˈfreɪd/
dialogue.zh: 恐怕維修人員九點前無法處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, nine is too late for me, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm naɪn ɪz tu leɪt fər mi ˈɑ·nəst·li/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，老實說九點對我太晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem — we can switch your room now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑ·bləm wi kæn swɪtʃ jɔr rum naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題——我們現在就能幫您換房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Which room? Same floor, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪ·li wɪtʃ rum seɪm flɔr aɪ hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？換哪間？希望同一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room 412, up one floor, same bed size.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ˈfɔr·tɪn tu ʌp wʌn flɔr seɪm bɛd saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 412 房，樓上一層，床也一樣大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works! Do I have to pack again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks du aɪ hæv tə pæk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我還得重新打包行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our bellhop will move your bags — don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ˈbɛlˌhɑp wɪl muːv jɔr bæɡz doʊnt ˈwɜ·ri/
dialogue.zh: 行李員會幫您搬，請放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're so kind. Um, one more small thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr soʊ kaɪnd ʌm wʌn mɔr smɔl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 您真是太好了。呃，還有一件小事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes? We'll take care of breakfast today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wil teɪk ˈkɛr əv ˈbrɛk·fəst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是的？今天的早餐由我們招待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful — thanks for turning it around.
dialogue.zh: 太好了——謝謝你讓事情轉向圓滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our pleasure. Dial zero anytime you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ˈplɛ·ʒər daɪəl ˈzi·roʊ ˈɛ·niˌtaɪm ju niːd/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們應該做的。有需要隨時撥零。
